proposal.root_cause: Commit ac2d38a added env DB_URL="" to the api Deployment. It takes precedence over envFrom api-config (DB_URL=redis://redis:6379), so the app exits with "DB_URL not set".
proposal.rationale: Previous-container logs show "DB_URL not set". The diff of ac2d38a shows only the empty DB_URL env being added. The api-config ConfigMap already provides a valid DB_URL. Removing the override restores it.
proposal.verify: The api pod starts, DB_URL resolves to redis://redis:6379, /healthz returns 200, the pod becomes Ready, and the restarts stop.

spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: python:3.12-alpine
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: APP_VERSION
              value: "1.0.0"
            - name: DB_URL
              value: ""
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: api-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 96Mi
              cpu: 50m
            limits:
              memory: 128Mi
              cpu: 500m
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: api-code

  labels:

    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/api.yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app: api
  ports:
    - name: http
